summary: Adjusted the thread view header in Conversation.svelte and conversation.css so its title row matches the workspace screen's title row pixel-for-pixel: same background (--color-canvas), title font now --text-lg/700 (was 14px/650), and Tree/⋯ buttons moved into the shelf row while a New thread button now sits in the header. Fixed one integration test that asserted the Tree button's location, then re-ran all checks.
decisions: Set [data-ui='conversation'] background to var(--color-surface-raised) and conversation-header to var(--color-canvas) so the thread header matches the workspace screen's surface color.
Set conversation-header h1 to font-size var(--text-lg) (16px/700) to match the workspace screen title.

Moved the Tree trigger and MoreHorizontal menu out of conversation-header into conversation-shelf (right-aligned), and added a New thread button in conversation-header via an onNewThread prop, mirroring the workspace screen layout.
Use a fixed height on conversation-shelf (rather than min-height) so the buttons do not push the shelf line below 145px when they exceed tab strip height.
Set conversation-header padding to 10px var(--space-5) (was var(--space-6)) so the title x-coordinate aligns with the workspace screen title when switching views.

Updated the 'opens the Pi session tree from the thread header' integration test to assert the Tree button's closest element is [data-ui='conversation-shelf'] instead of [data-ui='conversation-header'].
errors: Integration test 'opens the Pi session tree from the thread header' failed with 'expected null not to be null' after Tree was moved into the shelf; fixed by updating the assertion's closest selector from conversation-header to conversation-shelf.
